purpose: Correct Oven V27's hob projection to Cabinet V11's shallow cutaway language, then correct the Broken roasting dish to the fixed On-state shelf height.

passes.name: first-shallow-hob-pass
passes.assessment: Direction improved, but native analysis still measured excessive combined side convergence, so this pass remains provenance only.

passes.name: final-restrained-convergence-pass
passes.assessment: Selected source for the V28 upper-hob patch. Deterministic construction uses only its Off-state upper 16 native body rows.

passes.name: broken-fixed-shelf-pass
passes.assessment: Moves the burnt roast and roasting dish off the open foreground door and onto the fixed interior shelf at the On-state height. Deterministic construction uses only the declared Broken cavity/door patch.

finalPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: high-resolution source sheet for a polished pixel-art game appliance. Flatten only the navy hob slab projection further. Its rear edge must be almost the same width as its front edge, matching the exact Cabinet V11 projection authority's extremely shallow worktop projection. At native 84-pixel oven width, combined left/right convergence must be no more than about 4–5 pixels. Reduce visible front-to-back top-surface depth accordingly. Keep a very small softly rounded diagonal return at each upper corner. Preserve every cream fascia pixel, rotary dial, red lamp, cavity, roasting item, Broken door/window, hanging two-wire dial, lower plinth, palette, scale and registration. Use one identical exterior hob envelope in all states. No cabinet pixels, countertop pixels, smoke, sparks, text or watermark.

deterministicUse.preservationRule: Replace native body rows 0–15 in every V27 state. In Broken variants only, also replace body rectangle x=8–75/y=26–66 with the fixed-shelf correction; retain all V27 pixels outside those two declared patches.
